title: Add Pricing to primary marketing navigation
description:
## Problem
Pricing is one of the first things visitors look for. It currently lives in the homepage Delegated Responsibility section (`id=\"delegated-responsibility\"`) and on `/beta` (`BetaSetupPricing`), with no Pricing item in the header.

## Decisions (locked)
1. Add a **Pricing** link to the desktop primary nav in `web/components/Header.tsx`, alongside Organization / Why Chatticus / Evidence / FAQ.
2. Destination: `/#pricing` (homepage anchor).
3. On the homepage pricing section (`web/components/DelegatedResponsibility.tsx`), set the section `id` to **`pricing`** (replace or alias `delegated-responsibility`). Keep the visible heading \"Delegated Responsibility\" unless a one-line subhead helps; do not invent a new pricing model.
4. Include Pricing in the new mobile nav menu (see mobile-nav task) with the same destination.
5. Optional: add Pricing to the Footer Product column pointing to `/#pricing`.
6. Do not create a separate `/pricing` route in this task.

## Done when
- Desktop header shows Pricing
- `/#pricing` scrolls to the pricing/delegated-responsibility content
- Mobile menu includes Pricing when that task lands (same PR preferred)
